Scenario: file server encrypted, .locked extension

Inject 1: last backup job failed silently, 11 days ago
Inject 2: on-call contact list has an ex-employee's number
Inject 3: two people both think they're Accountable
           for approving contact with the negotiator
caption: Three real gaps -- none of them visible just by re-reading the plan on paper.

code:
Finds gaps in the plan + playbooks, while there's time to fix them
Builds the team's muscle memory in their own roles
Costs a conference room and two hours
  -- vs. learning the same gaps during a real incident
